Last Riders is dropped to all players (regardless of whether they participate in the kill, or are even in the room). It remains for approximately 30 seconds before disappearing. Has a base drop rate of 1/250, but after 250 kill count, each kill will decrease the denominator by 1, so it is a guaranteed drop on a solo kill with a kill count of at least 499. Having a Lorehound summoned with the Lore Helper perk increases the drop rate.

When Vorago is killed, up to 10 players are eligible to receive loot, but only five people can obtain a rare item. Vorago's seismic weapons constitute the normal drop in a drop pile. The chance of getting a specific seismic item is 1/240 per item per slot, making any seismic drop 1/120 per slot, or 1/24 per kill; however, only 1 unique weapon can be dropped per kill, if at all. During hard mode, drop chance for any seismic is 1/60 per slot, or 1/12 per kill. Drop rate increased by 1% with tier 4 luck .
